text:
nina (Design): quick copy nit — the inline helper under the prompt input is too long and wraps on narrow panes. current: `e.g. \"Summarize this email in 3 bullets\"`. want a one-line, actionable sample that also hints at length.
omar (Eng): agree. it's rendered inside the input chrome so space is tight. reusing examples from docs would be nice for consistency.
felix (PM): goals: teach one concrete prompt, show desired length, fit single line. keep tone helpful not prescriptive.
jin (A11y): ensure it's readable by screen readers as a single phrase. avoid fancy dashes. parens are OK.
lex (Docs): docs prefer sentence case and no trailing punctuation. localizers will want the example isolated.
i18n-bot: note: wrap the example in a single translatable string token.
nina (Design): proposing three compact options (<=40 chars):
1) Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)
2) Example: Summarize this email	6 3 bullets
3) Summarize this email	5 3 bullets
omar (Eng): 1 is clean. 2's dash might get misread. 3 lacks an action prefix.
jin (A11y): vote 1. add aria-describedby="prompt-helper" and role="note" so SRs announce it.
felix (PM): locking on 1: `Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)`. i'll add a tiny helper under the input: `Tip: include desired length, e.g. 3 bullets` in the modal.
omar (Eng): implementation snippet:
```
<InputHelper id="prompt-sample" aria-describedby="prompt-input" text={"Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)"} maxWidth={360} />
```
omar (Eng): i'll clamp at 320px and add a test to ensure `Try:` isn't truncated.
lex (Docs): please avoid smart quotes in the string token.
i18n-bot: flagged and noted for localization team.
nina (Design): thanks — i'll update the component token and ping i18n once merged.
